description: The Plugins page's intro. Socio is the product's name; a service runs beside it as its own program.
search: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field over the plugins.
datasets-failed: Error toast when installing a plugin could not load which workspace datasets it uses.
loading: Accessible name of the placeholder shown while the plugins load.
tabs.label: Accessible name of the page's tabs.
tabs.discover: Tab: the catalog of plugins to install.
tabs.installed: Tab: the plugins installed on this instance.
empty-catalog.title: Title shown when this instance's catalog lists no plugins.
empty-catalog.body: Text under it. PLUGIN_CATALOGS is a server setting's name; keep it.
categories.scheduling: Category of plugins: calendars, queues and planning.
categories.publishing: Category of plugins: where a draft is published.
categories.analytics: Category of plugins: numbers about what was published.
category-count: Under a category's name: how many plugins (here called apps) are in it.
popular: Heading of a row of plugins, the most installed first.
recent: Heading of a row of plugins, the newest first.
empty-view.title: Shown in a row when the search or category leaves no plugin.
card.installed: Badge on a catalog card: the plugin is installed here.
card.not-installed: Badge on a catalog card: the plugin isn't installed.
card.details: Button on a catalog card that opens the plugin's details.
detail.meta: Line under a plugin's name in its details: {{author}} who made it, {{version}} its version, {{display}} how it opens, {{mode}} how it runs.
detail.back: Button back from a plugin's details to the catalog (the store).
detail.manage: Button on an installed plugin's details that opens its admin page.
detail.screenshots: Heading over pictures of the plugin.
detail.permissions: Heading over what the plugin may do.
detail.status: Line on an installed plugin's details: whether it is enabled, then where to open or change it (Installed is the tab's name).
screenshots.week.title: Caption title of a mock picture of a week's calendar.
screenshots.week.caption: Caption of that picture.
screenshots.composer.title: Caption title of a mock picture of a post editor.
screenshots.composer.caption: Caption of that picture. X is the social network's name.
screenshots.composer.draft: Placeholder text inside the mock editor.
screenshots.composer.account: A made-up social media account's name in the mock post.
screenshots.composer.preview: Text inside the mock post's preview.
empty-installed.title: Shown on the Installed tab when nothing is installed.
manage: Link from an installed plugin's row to its admin page.
manage-label: Accessible name of that link. {{name}} is the plugin's name.
